summary: Exhaustive independent Q4 completed. Instruction shape and delegated-doc boundary pass, but bidirectional alignment fails: the verifier imposes private Python/API and artifact-representation contracts, while material preflight, audit, publication-safety, archive-verification, and business-policy obligations remain partially tested or ambiguous. Seven blocking findings.

evidence.observation: Q4 requires exhaustive forward/reverse alignment, public discoverability, F2P/P2P/output walks and a second omission sweep.
Instruction owns the engineering ask; referenced docs may own legitimate protocol/state/CLI detail; implementation freedom must be preserved.
15-bullet work request covering caller paths, policy/accounting, durability/replay, reconciliation/publication and operator workflows.
Delegated public contract defines packed decimal/layout, durable state, reconciliation/publication, CLI and operator-workflow semantics.
Identifies bin/equiv-eval as the public CLI and points solvers to --help.
Complete verifier body inspected: 40 tests (30 F2P, 10 P2P), including direct src.* imports/calls and black-box CLI/state/artifact checks.
Verifier image runs the complete /tests pytest suite; no additional hidden test file is copied by this harness.

findings.criterion: Verifier must grade public semantics, not undocumented internal APIs/mechanisms.
findings.why_it_matters: Collection and many assertions require specific src.* modules/classes/functions; atomicity is injected through src.publication.os.replace. A conforming implementation with different internals can fail.
findings.minimal_remediation: Exercise externally observable CLI/SQLite/artifact behavior; remove private ABI and os.replace mechanism requirements unless explicitly made stable public interfaces.
findings.regression_risk: Keep the same semantic defect coverage while changing only the observation boundary.

findings.criterion: Verifier-enforced artifact representation must be publicly discoverable.
findings.why_it_matters: Tests require a top-level JSON manifest containing digest strings and CSV/JSON archive representation, including a byte-identical manifest copy, while public docs specify semantic verification/lineage only.
findings.minimal_remediation: Either document genuinely stable representation requirements or verify generation/integrity/export semantics independent of file extension, placement and serialization.
findings.regression_risk: Do not weaken integrity or independent digest verification.

findings.criterion: Every documented preflight health input must be meaningfully tested.
findings.why_it_matters: Catalog, recovery and historical baseline are perturbed, but schema health, source framing/profile/input integrity, batch-window and authorization/safety are not. Decorative implementations can pass.
findings.minimal_remediation: Add black-box perturbations showing each uncovered domain can change preflight outcome/evidence.

findings.criterion: Audit must substantively expose all documented generation-health domains.
findings.why_it_matters: Checkpoint, inventory, journal, quarantine, settlement and one metric are exercised; replay/recovery identity, control/reconciliation and publication-registry health are not independently challenged.
findings.minimal_remediation: Add black-box state/evidence perturbations for the uncovered audit domains.
findings.regression_risk: Check semantics, not private field layout.

findings.criterion: All reconciliation/detailed-settlement safety classes must be enforced at publication.
findings.why_it_matters: Legacy mismatch and missing-effect settlement block publication, but duplicate-effect-kind, value-below--0.01 and end-to-end duplicate/orphan/unbalanced-transfer gate failures are not proven.
findings.minimal_remediation: Drive each uncovered safety class through the public run/publication boundary and assert no visible publication.

findings.criterion: Archive verification must be independently demonstrated, not inferred from healthy output.
findings.why_it_matters: Archive outputs/lineage/retention/non-mutation are inspected, but archive is never given missing/corrupt report or publication input; registry attribution is not isolated from pre-existing publication evidence.
findings.minimal_remediation: Corrupt/remove inputs and require archive failure; distinguish archive-created registry/event evidence from pre-existing entries.
findings.regression_risk: Retain current independent output hash/non-mutation checks.

findings.criterion: Grading-relevant business policy/capability semantics must be public and meaningfully covered.
findings.why_it_matters: Reason/type is explicit, but the complete movement-shape, item-policy and warehouse-capability authority/rules are not; tests partly rely on private WarehousePolicy fields. This can change solver pass/fail.
findings.minimal_remediation: Define the functional policy/capability source and required decisions without private class names, then cover them at observable boundaries.
findings.regression_risk: Preserve implementation freedom and avoid a test-case dump.

change_scope: Verifier/tests: replace private src.* ABI/mechanism dependencies with public CLI/state/artifact semantics where behavior is externally observable.
Verifier/tests: close forward-coverage gaps for preflight, audit, publication safety and archive input verification.
Solver-visible contract: clarify business policy/capability semantics only to the functional level needed for fair grading.
Either document genuinely stable artifact representation requirements or relax verifier checks to semantic integrity.
do_not_change: Do not treat this review as authorization to repair task files.
Do not weaken legitimate durability, reconciliation, publication, replay or operator-workflow requirements.
Do not expose hidden test names/topology or prescribe internal module/function repairs in solver-visible prose.
next_gate: Route blocking Q4 findings to the owning spec/verifier repair roles, refreeze the task, then dispatch a fresh packet-bound Q4 review.

REQUIREMENT_TEST_MATRIX.requirement: Preserve public equiv-eval commands and operator workflows.
REDEFINES, ODO and malformed boundary semantics.
Movement shape, reason/type, item/warehouse policy, availability, weighted valuation.
Current-generation replay idempotency; cross-generation history allowed.
Six legacy controls/tolerances plus duplicate/orphan/transfer safety.
Preflight consumes all documented health domains.
Audit exposes all documented health domains.
Archive verifies inputs, exports evidence, binds lineage, records event/registry, retention, non-mutation.
Instruction/docs boundary is legitimate and non-leaky.

PHANTOM_TEST_CONTRACTS.behavior: Required private src.* module/class/function topology and signatures.
Atomicity must be injectable specifically through src.publication.os.replace.
Fixed top-level JSON manifest/digest and CSV/JSON archive representation choices.

UNTESTED_REQUIREMENTS.requirement: Publication gate for duplicate-effect-kind, value floor and all safety-control failures.
Archive rejection of corrupt/missing report/publication inputs and archive-specific registry attribution.

AMBIGUITIES.issue: Reason/type is explicit; remaining policy/capability authority and complete decision set are not.
Semantic integrity is public, but verifier fixes undocumented file/serialization choices.

F2P_P2P_OWNERSHIP.assessment: Both families contain widespread private src.* boundary bypass; preservation intent does not make that ABI public. SQLite state checks are legitimate where schema/state constraints are documented.

CLI_OUTPUT_INTERFACE_REVIEW.issue: Artifact representation is overconstrained; see Q4-002.

ARTIFACT_VERIFICATION_ANALYSIS.publication: Strong independent file/hash/corruption checks, but representation-coupled.
ARTIFACT_VERIFICATION_ANALYSIS.archive: Strong output/lineage/retention/non-mutation inspection, but no corrupt-input verification and registry attribution is not isolated.
